biggest_catch: Pay is fully variable: caregivers set their own prices and official evidence only confirms customer-facing typical walk prices ($15-$45) plus 100% of tips — the caregiver take-home share is not stated in official terms, and bookings are never guaranteed.
catches: Pay is variable and demand-driven: caregivers set their own prices and compete for requests; no guaranteed bookings or hours. Official evidence confirms customer-facing typical prices ($15-$45/walk) and 100% tip retention, but not the caregiver's share of the walk price.
Must pass an enhanced background check (identity, criminal, and other checks) plus a pet safety quiz; failing means rejection.
You are an independent contractor: no benefits, and you cover your own transport/time between jobs.
Must be 18+ with valid ID and SSN.
Earnings depend on location, availability, ratings, and tips.

Caregivers set their own prices, so typical rates run from $15 to $22, $20 to $29, and $30 to $45.' And: 'Tipping is optional and always appreciated. Walkers keep 100% of their tips.'
payout_value_note: Variable: official wagwalking.com evidence establishes customer-facing typical walk prices ($15-$22/20-min, $20-$29/30-min, $30-$45/60-min) and that walkers keep 100% of tips; caregivers set their own prices but no official source states the caregiver take-home share of the walk price, so no verified dollar payout range.

steps: Submit the online Pet Caregiver application on wagwalking.com.
Complete identity verification (valid ID + SSN) and the enhanced background check.
Pass the Wag! pet safety quiz and obtain endorsements.
Download the Wag! Pet Caregiver app, complete a test walk, and set up Stripe for payouts.
Set your own prices and accept walk, sitting, boarding, or drop-in requests in the app.
timing: Application approval takes days; paid per completed service via Stripe.
